A person in the overlap is seen by both, and adding the counts double-counts.
Each unit processes frames on the device and outputs counts only; no frame ever leaves the unit.
At install time, the overlap zone is marked in each unit's own pixel coordinates.
Each unit reports two integers every 30 seconds: total people seen, and people seen inside the overlap zone.
The room aggregator computes room count = A + B - min(overlap_A, overlap_B).
Above room level, counts roll up to floors, and any room with a single regular occupant is grouped with its neighbours so no one person is singled out.
